units.source_text: 奇怪的是，我越说："我不爱你"，她就越发深深地沉溺在爱我的错觉中。

en.t: Strangely, the more I said, "I do not love you," the more deeply she sank into the illusion that I loved her.

units.source_text: 于是，一天晚上，她终于大胆地委身在我的面前。

en.t: Then, one night, she finally gave herself to me boldly, right before my eyes.

units.source_text: 她的身体实在美到了极点。

en.t: Her body was truly beautiful to the utmost degree.

units.source_text: 但是，我却是个没有性功能的人。

en.t: But I was a person without sexual function.
